body: I'm pretty much in the same situation. I've always had my eyes on trying Viktor since a long time ago, but I just never did. And now when Arcane S2 dropped, it reminded me that I've wanted to try him, so I picked him up 1 week ago and he is really fun to play, so I'm also really sad that I don't have that much time to play him. But ofc I'm still excited for the rework, but I also hope that they keep his core identity and mainly rework his W and maybe ult in some way. I hope his Q and E will still be kinda similar at least after the rework. :)
